name: epaper_header
title: E-paper screen
purpose: 8-pin header for a Waveshare 1.54" e-paper module (200 x 200, SPI) on its cable

sources.title: Waveshare 1.54inch e-Paper Module manual (wiki)
sources.read: pin table, operating voltage, header pitch, resolution, SPI mode

sources.title: KiCad 10 standard libraries (symbols, footprints, 3D models)
sources.read: symbol pin numbers, footprint pads, 3D models

parts.quote: "The pitch of the 8-pin connectors on the e-Paper display hats is 0.1 inch (2.54 mm)."; pins VCC, GND, DIN, CLK, CS, DC, RST, BUSY (the page's pin table, in its order)

+3V3.note: "3.3V / 5V"; the panel runs at 3.3 V (waveshare_epd154); refresh power "26.4mW (typ.)"

/EPD_DIN.note: SPI data in: RP2040 SPI0 TX (GPIO19)

/EPD_BUSY.note: busy status from the panel: an input

layout.rules: Pin order is the wiki's pin table order; the module's cable plugs on by its labels.

open_questions: The module (48 x 33 mm driver board) sits on its cable off the board; no mounting for it yet.
The header's pin order follows the wiki's table, not a stated connector pin numbering: check the cable's labels when plugging in.
